Disabling include_document_structure still produces content without the document tree overhead

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":false}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
